title: Project package import boundary
summary: Runtime stages and validates a .luvi package, asks the sandboxed canonical parser for its documents/media and commits a settled Project document through the Project broker. Engine export format is engine.gemia.

carrier.notes: Gate execution_id is execution_ plus the first 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical product/account/session/root-turn/turn/capability/resource-scope data. Scope includes project_revision and authorization context. A proven-not-started step terminalizes RELEASED; the identical request replays its failed outcome, rather than running again.

replaceability.why: Holds Project ownership, durable integrity or trusted execution authority.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: validate_package
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced.

operations.name: bind_luvi_read
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. Returns a runner for luvi-import; parsing untrusted ZIP happens in the sealed engine. Only staged media files are produced; no Project write and no revision change. Opaque runner output is draft.

operations.name: write_luvi_export_input
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. Writes scratch request only; no client_op_id Project commit. Repeating overwrites the same request name.

operations.name: bind_luvi_commit
operations.notes: No local operation deadline is enforced. Returns trusted broker; imports the settled document as one governed edit, not synthetic insert history. Exact Gate execution replays. Document/revision are separate file replacements with no atomic client_op_id result record.

invariants.text: Package parsing does not import gemia into the Runtime; package media is staged under scratch before governed import.
For governed calls, a definitive no-side-effect failure is RELEASED and the identical execution identity replays that failure. A new attempt must not be disguised as a retry.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Replacement conformance is not wired at this seam.

known_deviations.text: Import explicitly drops 1.0 history and redo, rather than pretending the Runtime keeps that journal.

The document commit still uses the shared two-file mutation, not a crash-atomic client_op_id result transaction. Media imports and document replacement must not be replayed as one unguarded operation.
The execution journal stores immutable effect results separately from Project persistence. It does not make the Project document, revision and client_op_id result record one atomic commit.
